examples: 'SAntAM tasmE pradAsyati. svakAM duhitaraM BAryAm' (rA॰1.8.25).
'pra vAM Gftasya nirRijo dadIran' (f॰7.64.1).
'aTEnaM mAtre pradAya stanaM prayacCati' (Sa॰brA॰14.9.4.28). atrodAhftizu praSabdena nArTaH.
'hutaSezaM pradadyAttu BAjanezu (yAjYa॰1.236). nikzipedityarTaH.
'AjYApaya kimeteByaH pradAyaM dIyatAm iti' (BA॰ASrama॰14.9). pradAyaH=dAyaH=pradeSanam, upadA, upAyanamupagrAhyam.
'pradAnaM pradAya yAjayitavyameva' (Sa॰brA॰12.8.1.17) .
'yadi vAcaM pradAsyAmi dvijAtiriva saMskftAm' (rA0 5.20.18). pradAsyAmi uccArayizyAmi, vyAharizyAmi, vakzyAmi.
'yaTA vatsena prattAM gAM duhe' (tE0 saM0 2.3.6.23). prattAM kzIraM dAtumArabDAm. prasnutastanImiti yAvat. AdikarmaRi nizWA. praSabdaScAdikarmaRo dyotakaH.
'prattA vE gOrduhe' (tE0 saM0 1.7.1.3). ukto'rTaH.
'kAmodakaM saKi prattAsvasrIyaSvaSurartvijAm' (yAjYa0 3.4). prattA pariRItA. datteti tvakzarArTaH. kAmodakaM kArya kAme pretAByudayakAmanAyAM satyAmiti mitAkzarA.
'lubDaM hanyAtsaMpradAnena nityam' (BA0 SAM0 120.47). sampradAnena=upagrAhyEH, upadABiH.
'ahanyahani cApyevaM yAcatAM sampradIyate' (BA0 vana0 95.21). sampradIyate=vitIryate, pradiSyate.
'tasmE vasavaH prAtaH savanaM samprayacCanti' (CA0 u0 2.24.6). samprayacCanti pradadati.
'kumAraM mAtApitarO triH samprayacCete' (ko0 sU0 54). samprayacCete=anyonyasmE pradattaH. dARaH prayoge praSabdaH sampro vA prAyeRa samaM vyavahriyete.
'hiraRyaM sampradAyaM zoqaSinA stuvate' (tARqya0 12.13). sampradAyam=pradAya. sampradAyamiti Ramulantam.

'sampradAyEva tezAM' (karma0) (BA0 u0 27.25). praRamya BagavatpAdAn SrIDarAdIMSca sadgurUn. sampradAyAnusAreRa gItABAzyaM samAraBe.. sampradAyaH=guruSizyAnukrameRa prAptaH SAstropadeSaH. asampradattA (kanyA)=pitrA vivAhe'dattA, anUQeti yAvat.
'dIyatAM sampradAnam' (rA0 4.11.34). prItidAnam ityAha.
'AtmanaH sampradAnena martyo mftyumupASnute' (BA0 SAM0 246.8). sampradAnena=vizayeByaH samarpaRena.
'sa tadAnIM mahAbudDirmahamUdaM madodDatam. taddurgadvitayIdAnasampradAnamamanyata' (Si0 BA0 15.46).. sampradAnaM sampradIyate'smA iti pratigrahotocyate.
'marudByaH sampraditsAMcakAra' (ni0 1.5.13). dAtumiyeza.
'aTAtaH samprattiH' (bfha0 u0 1.5.17). samprattiH sampradAnam.
'ftvija ftuyAjAnyajantyasampradAyam' (E0 brA0 5.9). asampradAyam anyasmA adattvA. Ramulantametat.
'dIyatAM sampradAnaM ca parizvajya ca vAnarAn' (rA0 4.11.34). sampradAnaM deyadravyam.
'dakziRAM vyadadAttezAM karmiRAM tadanantaram. prAcIM hotre dadO' (goresiyo saM0 rA0 1.13.39). vyadadAt=viBajyAdadAt.
'vi mahacCarma yacCa' (aTarva0 1.20.3). viyacCa=viSezeRa prayacCa.
'vi manyo Sarma yacCa' (f0 10.152.5). ukto'rTaH.
'tezAM yaTAguRamAvasaTAH SazpAnnapAnaM ca videyam' (Apa0 Da0 2.25.9). videyaM viSezeRa deyam.
'anugrahaM kuru viBo vidAyaM dehi sAmpratam' (brahmavE0 1.23.39). viSizwo dAyo vidAyaH.
'hastO pfRasva bahuBirvasavyErAprayacCa dakziRAdota savyAt' (aTarva0 7.28.8). AprayacCa ABimuKyena dehItyarTaH.
'sahasraM vE prati puruzaH paSUnAM prati yacCati' (tE0 saM0). puruzaH sahasrasya paSUnAM BAreRa tulyaBAro BavatItyarTaH.
'tileByaH prati yacCati mAzAn' (pA0 2.3.11 ityatrodAharaRam). tilAnAdAya tadarTe mAzAn dadAti. iha pratiH karmapravacanIyaH.
'etadAdAya te prARAn pratidAsyanti pARqavAH' (BA0 sO0 15.27). pratidAsyanti=praRidAsyanti vinimAsyante.
'manyasva naradevAya jAnakI pratidIyatAm' (rA0 5.51.21). AttapUrvAyAH sItAyA dAnaM pratidAnam. jAnakI pratyarpyatAmityarTaH.
'adyApi kopavimuKIkftagantukAmA noktaM vacaH pratidadAti yaTEva pUrvam' (cOra0 36). uktaM vaco na pratidadAti na pratisandiSatItyarTaH.
'sandeSaM pratidAsyAmi vizRoH' (hari0 7250). pratisandeSaM dAsyAmItyarTaH.
'pratidAsyAmi Bagavan pu~lliNgaM tava suvrata' (BA0 u0 192.6). pUrvamAttaM pratyarpayizyAmItyarTaH.
'dattEzA BavatA mahyaM tAM te pratidadAmyaham' (BA0 ASva0 89.17). ukto'rTaH.
'ihEva santaH prati dadma enat' (aTarva0 6.117.2). enadfRaM pratidadmo vigaRayAmaH pratiniryAtayAmaH.

'yatra KalvekaH pratyAdeyaM dadAti dvitIyaSca pratideyaM gfhRAti tatrAsya dfzwatvAtpraDAnamfRaSabdaH' (nyA0 sU0 4.1.60 BA0). pratideyaM punardeyam. pumAnupaniDirnyAsaH pratidAnaM tadarpaRam ityamaraH. pratIpaM dAnaM pratidAnamiti svAmI.
'tasmAdapi vaDyaM prapannaM na pratiprayacCanti' (tE0 saM0 6.5.8.29-30). na pratiprayacCanti na pratyarpayanti.
